title: Implement per-user initiative controls module
description:
Create chatbot/agency/initiative.py implementing the InitiativeLevel enum, InitiativeSettings dataclass, per-user get/set operations, quiet hours support, and a default-level provider from operator configuration.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/agency/__init__.py (created by task a.1)
- chatbot/db/models.py (for existing user/settings tables)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/agency/initiative.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.

Implementation:

1. chatbot/agency/initiative.py:
  - InitiativeLevel enum (enum.Enum): NEVER = 'never_proactive', REMINDERS = 'reminders_only', GENTLE = 'gentle_checkins', FREQUENT = 'frequent', HIGH_ENERGY = 'high_energy'.
  - InitiativeSettings dataclass: user_id (str), level (InitiativeLevel default GENTLE), quiet_hours_start (str|None, HH:MM), quiet_hours_end (str|None, HH:MM).
  - Module-level _default_level: InitiativeLevel = InitiativeLevel.GENTLE, settable via set_default_level().
  - _settings dict: dict[str, InitiativeSettings] for in-memory v1 storage.
  - get_initiative(user_id) -> InitiativeSettings: returns stored or default.
  - set_initiative(user_id, settings) validates HH:MM format for quiet hours.
  - get_effective_level(user_id) returns current level considering overrides.
  - is_in_quiet_hours(user_id) handles quiet hours spanning midnight.
  - can_initiate(user_id) returns False when level is NEVER or during quiet hours.
  - set_default_level(level) / get_default_level() for operator config.
  - class ProjectInitiative: wrapping module-level helpers with an async interface matching other agency modules.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/agency/initiative.py exists and defines InitiativeLevel, InitiativeSettings, ProjectInitiative
InitiativeLevel enum has NEVER, REMINDERS, GENTLE, FREQUENT, and HIGH_ENERGY values
get_initiative() returns default settings when user has no stored settings
set_initiative() validates HH:MM format for quiet_hours
is_in_quiet_hours() handles quiet hours spanning midnight
can_initiate() returns False when level is NEVER
can_initiate() returns False during quiet hours
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify chatbot/agency/__init__.py or other agency modules
add timezone libraries (use built-in datetime only)
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: store per-user settings in an in-memory dict for v1
use HH:MM string format for quiet hours times
handle quiet hours wrapping across midnight
forbidden: add pytz or any timezone library dependency
add database-backed settings storage (use in-memory dict for v1)
add rate limiting or cooldown logic
